sara: Morning — quick async standup focused on gateway / routing / auth / rate limits. Drop 1-liners (what I did / blockers / today). I'll start:

jordan: Done: started canary for routing v3 -> 20% traffic. Observed small uptick in 429s (thinburst paths ~0.2%). Blocker: need a per-route token-bucket tweak. Today: open PR with throttle map change. @mike can you eyeball after lunch?

mike: Ack. Saw the alerts. Reproducer for staging: `wrk -t2 -c200 -d30s` against `/v1/generate` with tiny payloads (triggers thinburst). Blocker for me: need CI flakiness fixed. Today: will review jordan's PR after lunch.

lee: Did: landed auth middleware fix for expired KID handling. Blocker: no unit test for key-rotation edge case yet. Today: add tests and validate rotation job against staging keys.

anya: Did: updated routing policy docs + migration notes (docs repo). Blocker: waiting on schema tweak from jordan to finalize examples. Today: prep rollout checklist + sample curl snippets.

sara: Quick config sanity-check: seeing discrepancy in gateway defaults — snippet shows: ```yaml
route_defaults:
  burst: 50
  rate: 10
``` should internal services be `burst: 100` instead?

mike: I think global default 100 is too permissive for shared ingress. For internal services we should pin routes to the `dedicated` pool and use per-route override. Don't change global default.

jordan: Agree with mike. I'll add a `burst_override` field to the policy schema and include defaults in the PR.

lee: Can we add a smoke test that exercises token-bucket boundaries? I can add a simple script to `smoke-tests/` that ramps to 1.5x burst.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary promote started by jordan at 1748456805 — routing/v3 -> 20%

anya: Also pinging @sara about yesterday's 429 postmortem notes. I put initial timeline in #incidents, want to sync with SRE on root cause (queue/backpressure vs token-bucket).

sara: Thanks — I'll create a follow-up Jira card for the per-route smokecheck + assign owners. Tagging eng-platform.

mike: :thumbsup: I'll review jordan's PR after lunch. If green, propose bump to 50% tonight.

jordan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4823 — tests failing on one flaky fixture, chasing it now.

lee: FYI I'll be OOO 3pm-5pm for a dentist appointment. Ping on Slack for anything urgent.
